title: "Module 6: Discussion and Implications"

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {quiz, notes, checklist} from "./helpers.js"
```

## Module overview

We integrate the whole study. You work with groups to discuss the findings, controls, assumptions and implications, and connect the results to the claims made in the introduction.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you should be able to:

- Discuss the findings of this study with peers.
- Summarize the results, implications, and discussion in text and as a concept map.
- Integrate the findings of the study with the methods used and claims made.
- Situate the findings of the paper within the field of study.

## Module to-do list

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
checklist("module-6-todo", ["Review the Delftia background before the first session", "Complete the in-class activity and submit before the end of the module", "Create a summary of the entire article and a concept map", "Write your own discussion for the article"])
```

## Return to the article

Review the figures and consider the claims the authors made. Remember this study was published in *Science*, a prestigious journal. Consider the Editor's Summary: is it accurate?

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
quiz("m6q1", "A strong discussion should…", ["Repeat the methods", "Tie findings back to the research question and note limitations", "Add new data", "List references only"], 1, "Connect findings to the claims and be candid about limits.")
```

## What were the main findings?

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
notes("m6-findings", "Summarize the main findings and implications.")
```

## Are the results convincing?

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
notes("m6-convincing", "What did the authors claim in the introduction? Are the results convincing? Why or why not?")
```

## Impact

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
notes("m6-impact", "How will these findings impact the field and future studies?")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
quiz("m6q2", "When judging whether results are convincing, you should…", ["Accept the authors' claims", "Check that the data, controls and assumptions support each claim", "Count the figures", "Ignore the methods"], 1, "Claims must be backed by the data and controls.")
```

::: {.takeaways}
### Key takeaways
- Summarize results, implications and discussion, and show them in a concept map.
- Integrate findings with the methods used and the claims made.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Article: Huang et al. (2023), *Delftia tsuruhatensis* TC1 symbiont suppresses malaria transmission by anopheline mosquitoes, *Science*. <https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adf8141>
:::
